semanticDecisions: contentEquals with a builder compares the builder's value array against the M3 storage in place (mismatchUnits), after the unchanged length check

chars() and codePoints() read the range once in bulk into a compact value; a UTF-16-coded range whose units all fit Latin-1 is narrowed (StringUTF16.compress) so the stream has the coder, characteristics and estimated size of the flat String of the same spelling (a slice of a UTF-16 owner with Latin-1 content was not SIZED before the narrowing; caught by the parity test)
the compact value is transient scratch of the range's size; nothing is retained
the two private M3String spliterators are removed: the stock spliterators over the compact value are the only stream path
